$note: Ways to get involved (CONTENT §3.8 + §4). Forms compose WhatsApp/email messages in Part A (A5).

ways.title: Sponsor a child
ways.text: Walk with one child from primary through secondary school, with school fees and ongoing mentorship.

ways.title: Pray with us
ways.text: Pray for the children and youth we serve, their families, and our tournaments and mentors.

ways.title: Volunteer or partner
ways.text: Help at tournaments, mentor young people, or partner with us as a church, school or business.

ways.title: Support a tournament
ways.text: Help us bring football, friendship and the Gospel to around 200 children and youth at a time.
